title: My Daughter-In-Law Sold My Inheritance Shop For $650K And Sent Me $3,500. So I Stitched The Proof.
description: When my daughter-in-law sold my $112K inheritance quilt shop and mailed me a $3,500 check, she thought she had gotten away with it. I found the original 50/50 agreement stitched inside a quilted wall hanging, proved her fraud in court, and now her garnished wages fund a women's shelter sewing program. #StitchOfBetrayal #FamilyBetrayal #QuiltingJustice
thumb_text: SHE LABELS EVERY QUILT 'I UNRAVELED FAMILY TRUST'
pinned_comment: If your daughter-in-law sold your $112K inheritance shop and mailed you a $3,500 check, would you have found the proof stitched in a quilt? Let me know in the comments.
